title.zh: 【Ramp 向 OCC 申请国家信托银行牌照，拟提供数字资产托管服务】
title.en: 【Ramp 向 OCC 申请国家信托银行牌照，拟提供数字资产托管服务】

current_state.zh: Ramp has applied to the OCC to establish Ramp National Trust Bank, which if approved would let it offer fiduciary investment management and digital asset custody without taking deposits or making commercial loans.
current_state.en: Ramp has applied to the OCC to establish Ramp National Trust Bank, which if approved would let it offer fiduciary investment management and digital asset custody without taking deposits or making commercial loans.
